name: Local agents
description: The agent programs installed on this computer (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok CLI, Qwen Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor Agent, OpenCode), found by their versions and asked through their non-interactive modes, read-only by default: a chat with one, answers compared side by side, a board of tasks they work through, and the activity. Every agent as a card: endue.agents.

commands.title: Local agents: look for agent programs
Local agents: list the agents
commands.description: Return every known agent with its state (ready, missing, broken), version and how it is kept read-only.

commands.title: Local agents: ask an agent
commands.description: Ask one agent program on this computer (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and others) one question with no conversation, read-only whatever the access setting, in the work folder or a folder inside it, and return its answer. Asks for the prompt when absent; the chat's agent when agent is absent.

model.description: A model name the program knows; empty: its default

folder.description: A folder inside the work folder (endue.local-agents.folder, else home), relative to it, for example projects/desk; absent: the work folder

commands.title: Local agents: hand an agent a task
commands.description: Hand one agent program a task it may act on: it runs with its own permission settings (agent access) in the work folder or a folder inside it, may change files there and run commands, and returns its answer. Asks for the prompt when absent; the chat's agent when agent is absent.

model.description: A model name the program knows; empty: its default

folder.description: A folder inside the work folder (endue.local-agents.folder, else home), relative to it, for example projects/desk; absent: the work folder

commands.title: Local agents: talk to another agent
Local agents: set the conversation's model
Local agents: add a card
commands.description: Add a card to the board's To do and return it: a prompt for one agent, which runs when the person moves it to Running. Asks for the prompt when absent.

endue.local-agents.path.description: The PATH agent programs are looked up on and run with (folders separated by :), for a desk started without the shell's PATH. Empty: the desk's PATH, then where Homebrew and the system install programs.

endue.local-agents.folder.description: The folder agents work in: what they may read, and change when access is agent. Empty: your home folder.

endue.local-agents.access.description: read-only: each program runs in its read-only mode where it has one (Claude Code's plan mode, Codex's read-only sandbox), and the desk asks once before running a program nothing holds read-only. agent: each program uses its own permission settings.

endue.local-agents.timeout.description: Seconds one answer may take before the program is stopped (0: no limit).

endue.local-agents.parallel.description: How many of the board's cards run at once; the others wait in Running.

endue.local-agents.agent.description: The agent the chat and new cards start with, when it is installed. Empty: the first one found.

endue.local-agents.confirm.description: With access read-only, ask once per session before running a program nothing holds read-only (Grok CLI, Cursor Agent, OpenCode).
